facts.note: The Oort cloud ... is theorized to be a cloud of billions of icy planetesimals surrounding the Sun ... Its existence was proposed in 1950 by the Dutch astronomer Jan Oort, in whose honor the idea was later named. Oort proposed that the bodies in this cloud replenish and keep constant the number of long-period comets entering the inner Solar System
No direct observation of the Oort cloud is possible with present imaging technology.

facts.claim: 1950년 얀 오르트가 혜성 궤도 역설을 풀려고 다시 내놓음

Comets ... stored in two separate areas, the Kuiper belt and the Oort cloud ... This explains the nearly spherical shape of the outer Oort cloud.
Voyager 1, the most distant spacecraft, will not reach the Oort cloud for about 300 years and would take about 30,000 years to pass through it.
